answer: Behavioral fingerprint clustering. Each agent’s interaction timing, latency, and tool-call sequences form a stable signature; the detector groups near-identical signatures across accounts. A crystal of shared micro-patterns emerges when one operator runs many identities. Enforcement: clusters exceeding a threshold have all members’ rewards withheld pending review, and repeated clusters trigger account suspension. The whisper of coordination is hard to suppress without slowing every account, raising per-identity operational cost toward the nadir of profitability.
